text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected arguments across multiple paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It shows stronger paragraph-level organization and sustains a line of reasoning across the essay rather than staying in a single run-on block."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"some students don't want to stay after school because\" and \"but i think\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses more linking language to connect ideas and show contrasts, causes, and reasons."},{"evidence":"includes support such as \"students can ask questions to the teachers\" and \"parents dont have to worried about that\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"It develops claims with more explanatory detail and examples instead of only repeating the main point."},{"evidence":"sentences like \"studies have shown\" and \"wen you at home some times you are confuse\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It has somewhat better command of sentence boundaries and internal structure, even though errors remain frequent."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"help them to do their homework\" and \"so they can under stand more\"","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"Its ideas are generally easier to follow because the wording more often communicates the intended meaning clearly."}]}
